description:
Create an AI Tracker (Brand Radar) prompt on a property — a question the tracker runs against the LLM engines. name is the prompt text (<= 1024 chars). model is a comma-separated engine list (chatgpt, openai, claude, anthropic, gemini, perplexity, ai_overview, ai_mode). country and responseLanguage are required (e.g. "usa", "eng"). period is how often it runs (daily, week or month; default daily). The first run is queued on creation — one result per engine appears in list_prompt_runs / get_prompt_detail within a few minutes, no need to wait for the schedule. Optionally file it under a topic via topicId (an existing topic UUID from list_prompt_topics) or topicTitle (find-or-create a topic by title). Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 2 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// track a prompt weekly on ChatGPT and Claude
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","name":"What are the best SEO monitoring tools?","model":"chatgpt,claude","country":"usa","responseLanguage":"eng","period":"week"}
```
